heading: Terminal triggers and editable snippets
summary: Create a trigger from selected terminal output and manage how SSH connections use Keychain.
changes: Create a trigger from selected text
Select terminal text, then right-click and choose Create Trigger from Selection. PromeFTP prepares an editable RE2 pattern and records matches as new output arrives.
Press ⌘P and use the pencil button to change a snippet’s name, command, or scope.
Open Preferences → Authentication → Keychain. OpenSSH Keychain access is off by default. Loading saved PAM answers is a separate option.
Connection options, PAM controls, and SFTP labels have more consistent alignment.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Triggers record matches in the terminal pane. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
